tool_name.description: Name used in the "flasher" setting of a board configuration.

tool_loc.description: Path to the tool executable. Leave blank to assume the tool is on PATH. Required for CLI-type tools.

type.description: Whether this tool is driven as an external CLI process or a built-in Python implementation.

supported_boards.description: Board types this tool can flash. See board_type.py for available options.

supported_file_types.description: Glob patterns of firmware file types this tool accepts.

custom_settings.description: Named presets of CLI arguments, keyed by the name shown in the settings dropdown. $variable substitution is supported (partid, port, baudrate, boardname, boardtype, file).

progress_bar.description: Settings relating to how the progress bar gets updated.

num_steps.description: Number of steps in the progress bar.

inc_step_on.description: Values that increment the progress bar. Starts with the first item; each time it matches in the output terminal, the bar advances and moves to the next item, wrapping around to the beginning.

regex_method.description: Which regex strategy "regex" mode uses: "normal" reads a current/total step count via step_read_regex/step_final_regex, "hex" reads hex memory addresses via initial_address/final_address/next_address. Defaults to "normal".

step_read_regex.description: regex_method "normal" only. A regex expression that looks for a percentage or x out of y expression to update the progress bar

step_final_regex.description: regex_method "normal" only. A regex expression that looks for the final amount of items to determine a step size

initial_address.description: regex_method "hex" only. A regex expression that matches the starting hex address of the flash range in the tool's output.

final_address.description: regex_method "hex" only. A regex expression that matches the ending hex address of the flash range; combined with initial_address to set the progress bar's maximum.

next_address.description: regex_method "hex" only. A regex expression that matches the current hex address reached; combined with initial_address to set the progress bar's value as flashing progresses.
